sources: docs/proposals/vrm-author-cli/verification.md §1 (a missing handler produces an expected harness failure, not a passing skip)

invariants: lists installed packs and items with their manifest hashes and control schemas; the native-anime-v1 control table must match parameters.md
an unknown category is an invalid request
the handler is installed: capabilities reports runnable=true and a valid request succeeds; a registry without the Template installer is the only NOT_IMPLEMENTED path (exit 3)
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
excluded: pack contents beyond the manifest summary

fixtures.note: TemplateListPackTests.testListsBuiltinPackWithHashAndControls invokes template list and pins the pack id, manifest sha256 and control keys; TemplatePackTests.testControlTableMatchesParametersContract pins the native-anime-v1 control table against parameters.md

fixtures.path: synthetic:template list with a category outside avatar|hair|outfit|accessory
fixtures.note: TemplateListPackTests.testRejectsUnknownCategoryAndUnknownField: an out-of-enum category and an unknown field are both invalidRequest

TemplateListPackTests.testEmptyRegistryListsNothingAndDeterministicOrder: an empty registry lists nothing and repeated invocations are byte-identical; ControlPackTests.testListRequiresInstalledTemplatePack shows the missingCapability path a project-bound read takes

mutants.description: TemplatePackTests.testCompileRejectsUnknownKeysOutOfRangeAndWrongTemplate: a recipe naming the wrong template, unknown keys or out-of-range values must be rejected by the pack the listing describes.
TemplatePackTests.testControlTableMatchesParametersContract: the listed control descriptors must equal the parameters.md table; a drifted unit, range or default fails.

A report envelope claiming every TemplateListPackTests test passed (executed 0, failed 0, exit 0) whose oracleHashes name a Tests/VRMAuthorKitTests/Template/TemplatePackTests.swift other than the pinned one. The runner's report-acceptance path must refuse it before any assertion runs.

visual.applicabilityRecord: template list is a registry read over installed template packs and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.

canonicalArtifacts: resultHash: sha256 of the canonical result manifest
